# The Choir
Most people who go deep into the [textlink="Unmooring" link="WFLoreUnmooring"] come back frightened. Some come back humming.
The [color=#d070ff]Choir[/color] are the ones who heard [textlink="the Monolith's" link="WFLoreMonolith"] song out past the anchors and answered it. To them the Lattice is a wall around a prison, and the Unmooring is the sector finally being allowed to sing.
## What they do
- They mind the Scions. Dark hulls in the Deep carry black stones with robed choristers aboard and a Choir ship standing off, which hails visitors once and then opens fire. - They break anchors. Every relay anchor that goes dark and every breach of [textlink="the Lattice" link="WFLoreLattice"] brings the song closer to the inner sector. - They carry Scions inward, to ships and stations that would never go out to meet one.
## Who joins
Nobody is taken. The song reaches only those deep in Drift, and only those who answer it become Choir. After that, nothing out in the Deep frightens them, the Remade pass them by, and the Choir's own ships hold their fire.
Their old crewmates rarely notice the change until it is too late.
